about: Stage 0 intent scenarios (docs/current feature planning/move-schema-post-auth/stage-0.md). Run by docs/proposals/move-intent-harness.js against the real sim for every routed move. Expected outcomes are written by hand from MOVE-INTENT (source MOVE-INTENT:<id>) or from the move data and the D-table (source data), never copied from the harness output. Layout: the owner stands at (0, 0) aiming along +x; enemies are [x, y] or [x, y, {overrides}] with radius 10 and huge HP. Defaults: owner cdMul 100 (one cast per scenario), rng never (every roll misses). Enemy indexes in expect are positions in the enemies list.

scenarios.note: arc 1.7 rad, radius 54 (slice 6, was 48): the enemy ahead is inside, one at 90 degrees is outside the arc, one at 80 px is past the reach
slice 6 (Jess 2026-10-31): radius 54, so with the enemy's 10 px body Tackle reaches 64 px: the enemy at 60 px is hit, the one at 70 px is not (48 would have missed both)
pierce 0 stops on the first enemy; contact after about 83 px at 310 px/s
1.6 s x 310 px/s = 496 px of travel along the aim, short of an enemy at 560. The second enemy (in range, off the aim line) is what lets a direction move cast at all (combat-architecture:H11 S2)
pierce 1 passes through one enemy and stops on the second
linear 250 x 30 aimed at the nearest: inside along 0 to 260 and within 25 px of the axis

wave (Jess 2026-11-02): band 16 deep at the nearest foe (100, 0), 300 px/s, width 60 + 0.667 per px travelled. Enemy r 10: on the axis hit once dist + 16 + 10 reaches it (100 at dist 74, 0.25 s; 300 at dist 274, 0.91 s). (100, 80): at most 133 wide over x 100, half + 10 = 77 < 80, a miss (narrow near the user). (200, 90): front reaches x 190 at dist 174, 176 wide, half + 10 = 98, a hit at 0.58 s. Behind the user: never.
6 projectiles evenly around the circle from the aim (0, 60, ... 300 degrees): 0 and 180 hit, 90 falls between two; foe Speed -1 (schema spd is stages spe, D31)

slice 5a (COMBAT-RULES Stat stages SS4, SS7): the foe Speed -1 lands on one tracker. Casts every 0.117 s refresh it inside the 6 s Gate and climb -1 at the first hit after each Gate opens (about 6 and 12 s), so 15 s reads -3; the next climb is past 18 s. Was -6 in 3 s under D-FOECAP (retired)
interval rehit 0.2 over a 1 s instance: hits at ages dt, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8 after the first
sticky aimTrack: the cast target dies on its first hit, then the cone turns toward the nearest at 1.4 rad/s and reaches the second enemy
arc 2.2 rad, radius 46: the enemy at 60 px is past the reach

two projectiles on one line both land: the first gives Speed -2, the second refreshes it while the Gate is closed (SS4), so one cast reads -2, plus trap (root). Was -4 under review 9.8 S7 (superseded 2026-10-30)

slice 6 (Jess 2026-10-31, #15): a still emitter fires a strand at once and a second 0.11 s later (35 px apart at 320 px/s). The first meets the enemy at 100 px after (100 - 7 - 10) / 320 = 0.26 s; both fly the same line, so they land 0.11 s apart (to the step), never in one frame; the emitter ends by time at 0.4 s

SS4: casts every 1.1 s, both strands landing within 0.6 s of each cast. The first landing starts the 6 s Gate; the cast at 6.6 s lands after it opens and climbs to -4; the next climb is past 12 s. 8.5 s ends between the 7.7 s cast landing and the 8.8 s cast
linear 290 x 20: inside to 300 along, within 20 px of the axis

slice 5a (SS4): three casts inside one 6 s Gate refresh the tracker, so it still reads -1. There is no per-move cap any more; Ice Beam climbs -1 per Gate on an enemy it keeps hitting (MOVE-INTENT ice-beam, 2026-10-30)

SS4 (MOVE-INTENT ice-beam, 2026-10-30): cd 1.75 s, one hit per cast (oncePerInstance, 0.5 s beam). The first hit (0 s) starts the 6 s Gate; casts at 1.75, 3.5 and 5.25 s refresh; the cast at 7.0 s lands with the Gate open and climbs to -2, restarting the Gate (open at about 13.0 s); 8.75, 10.5 and 12.25 s refresh. 13.5 s ends between cast 8 and cast 9 (14.0 s) at both dt (1/30 casts drift to every 1.767 s: cast 8 near 12.4, cast 9 near 14.2). Rolls miss (default rng), so no freeze
crit effect 15%: a roll of 0 always crits
heals half the damage dealt (D34; no Big Root here)
circle grows from 1 px at 500 px/s to max 200: reaches 100 at about 0.18 s, never 250
slice 5a (SS8): a pure buff has no cooldown and casts when its Gate opens: at 0, 6 and 12 s, +2 each, so +6 by 15 s; the next cast is at 18 s. cdMul does not apply

slice 5a (MOVE-INTENT dragon-dance, SS1 and SS8): one tracker each on Attack and Speed, +1 per climb; no early end (its 4 s exception is retired), still +1/+1 at 5 s, then the Gate opens at 6 s and both climb to +2
slice 5a (MOVE-INTENT aqua-ring 2026-10-31): 1/16 of 160 = 10 every 2 s from the spawn; one tick by 3.5 s (the next is near 4.0 s). Was 6.25% per second (three ticks)

persistent aura: one cast held active the whole time, no recast and no cooldown; ticks near 2, 4, 6, 8 and 10 s at both dt (1/30 lands near 2.03 ... 10.03), so 5 x 10 = +50. The slot-swap, stun and faint ends need a second group or a status, so they live in move-selfcast-harness.js section 9
pays 25% of max HP, raises a shield of twice that
fixed 40 to everything in the band, no type or defense
one hop within 150 px at x (1 - 0.33)
4 hops at x (1 - 0.33)^k (combat-architecture:D15); the sixth enemy is past the last hop
an enemy on the orbit is hit, burned at the full standard length and trapped, no stat strip
ring of 120 px, rehit 0.5, damage equal to the owner level (30)
an enemy on the orbit is hit many times; every hit is a new use that refreshes the self Sp. Atk -2 inside its 12 s Self-drop Gate (SS4, SS12), so it reads -2, not -4
SS2: a self change rolls on an enemy hit, so with nothing in reach it never applies

SS12: the self drop climbs on the 12 s Self-drop Gate, never the 6 s base Gate. Four leaves pass the enemy about every 0.31 s, so the first hit is by 0.31 s and the first hit after the Gate opens is by about 12.63 s: -2 at 7 and 11.5 s, -4 by 13 s
two leaves at +-0.25 rad, range 210: an enemy on each path takes one hit per leg
two bones at +-0.25 rad, range 230: 2 hits per enemy per bone, one per leg
dash to the target's centre, hit once there, return to the start

D-PSY: the cast target dies on its first hit, the wedge re-picks the nearest live enemy once and reaches it. Exact timing is checked by the 4c-3 handoff Test 6. Second enemy moved from (60, 90) to (100, 80) in the 4c-3 build: at 108 px it was nearer than the 120 px target, so it would have been the cast target; at 128 px it is not, and it stays more than 80 px from the apex (80 t, 0) until the re-pick
slice 6: all 7 bubbles reach an enemy 150 px out (lateral at most 10 px, inside 7 + 10); the last leaves at 0.45 s and lands by about 0.85 s
curving orbs reach about 160 px (2 x 80 x sin(1.5)), so an enemy at 300 is never hit
one boulder on the only enemy in range, after the 0.4 s telegraph
pierce 0: the orb ends on the first enemy, the one behind it is untouched

slice 6: 7 bubbles one after another on the aim line, each on its own 10 px / 1.5 Hz wave: at 60 px a bubble meets the enemy after about 0.14 s with lateral 10 sin(2 pi 1.5 x 0.14) = 9.7 px, inside 7 + 10, so all 7 land (each spent on contact); the last leaves at 0.45 s and lands by 0.6 s

slice 6 (Jess 2026-10-31): a still emitter fires a bubble every 0.075 s (25 px apart at 330 px/s), so the 7 hits come one after another, never in one frame. The first meets the enemy at 100 px after about 84.5 / 330 = 0.256 s (lateral 7.1 px, so contact at 100 - sqrt(17^2 - 7.1^2)); every bubble flies the same path, so the hit gaps are the emission gaps to the step (0.067 to 0.1 s at 1/30); the emitter ends by time at 0.6 s
the shot aimed along +x curves left on a circle of radius 120 / 1.5 = 80 around (0, 80); at 1 s it is at (80 sin 1.5, 80 (1 - cos 1.5)) = (79.8, 74.3)
arc 1.3 rad, radius 68: ahead is inside, 90 degrees is outside the arc, 90 px is past the 78 px reach
arc 1.2 rad, radius 50: ahead is inside, 90 degrees is outside, 70 px is past the 60 px reach
Fighting: a Normal enemy takes x1.6 and a Flying enemy x0.6 (the softened chart in types.js), so the ratio is 0.375 (a Normal-typed Karate Chop would give x1 and x1, ratio 1)
arc 0.8 rad, radius 64: ahead is inside, 90 degrees is outside, 80 px is past the 74 px reach
paralysis 30% on foe: a roll of 0 always procs
arc 1.6 rad, radius 50: ahead is inside, 90 degrees is outside, 70 px is past the 60 px reach
SS2: one roll per cast, on its first enemy hit (rng always: it lands); the other four hits of that cast do not roll, so the team reads +1
arc 1.7 rad, radius 48: ahead is inside, 90 degrees is outside, 65 px is past the 58 px reach
freeze 10% on foe: a roll of 0 always procs
arc 1.9 rad, radius 58: ahead is inside, 90 degrees is outside, 75 px is past the 68 px reach
arc 1.6 rad, radius 44: ahead is inside, 90 degrees is outside, 60 px is past the 54 px reach; berrySteal is a stub, so the hit just lands
cd 0.42 (cdMul 1): casts near 0, 0.42 and 0.84 s; a fourth would need 1.26 s

half circle (3.14 rad) growing 1 to 130 px at 650 px/s over 0.2 s, aimed at the nearest: the front and 30 degree flank are in, 90+ degrees behind the aim is out, 135 px is reached at about 0.19 s, 145 px is past the 140 px reach
full ring growing 1 to 380 px at 760 px/s over 0.5 s: all within the 390 px reach once, 395 px is out, 300 px is reached at about 0.39 s
full ring growing 1 to 200 px at 500 px/s over 0.4 s: within the 210 px reach once, 215 px is out
beam length 220, width 30: along -10 to 230 and side up to 25 px; 30 px to the side, 235 px along and behind are out
Sp. Def -1 at 10% on foe: a roll of 0 always procs
beam length 215, width 30: along -10 to 225 and side up to 25 px; 26 px to the side, 226 px along and behind are out
confusion 10% on foe (the first routed confusion rider on enemies): a roll of 0 always procs
travelling point, pierce 0: dies on the first enemy dead ahead; the one behind it and the one 30 px off the line (radius 4 + 10) are spared
travelling point 260 px/s, pierce 0: touches the enemy at 100 px (radius 9 + 10) near 0.31 s and dies; 40 px off the line is out
pierce 1: passes the first enemy, dies on the second; the third and the 40 px sideways one are spared
Sp. Def -1 at 20% on foe: a roll of 0 always procs
one chain hop (hopRange 60) from the struck enemy: the one 40 px behind it is hit at full power (ratio 1, no falloff entry); a second hop (190 px) and the one 90 px away are spared
hop reach is 60 px centre to centre: 59 px is chained
hop reach is 60 px centre to centre: 61 px is not chained
travelling point, pierce 0: dies on the first enemy; 40 px off the line (radius 7 + 10) is out
Speed +2 through D31; slice 5a (SS8): casts when its Gate opens, at 0, 6 and 12 s, +2 each, so +6 by 15 s
Defense +1; slice 5a (SS8): casts when its Gate opens, at 0, 6, 12, 18, 24 and 30 s, +1 each, so +6 by 33 s; the next cast is at 36 s
persistent static circle, radius 120: reach 130 px, every enemy once on the first step; 135 px is out
rehit 0.5: hits near 0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5 and 2.0 s from one instance; Sp. Def -1 on the first hit, and every later hit refreshes it inside its 6 s Gate (SS2, SS4), so -1 (not -5)

SS4: an enemy kept in the aura climbs -1 per Gate. Hits every 0.5 s from 0; climbs at the first hit once each 6 s Gate opens (6.0 or 6.5 s, then 12.0 to 13.0 s), so 14.8 s reads -3; the next climb is past 18 s. 14.8 keeps the last hit (14.5 s) off the 15.0 s frame edge
D-GUST: one emission of 3 shots at once at -0.25, 0, +0.25 rad (spread 0.5); an enemy on each line 150 px out is hit once (pierce 0), contact after about 133 px at 380 px/s; the emitter ends at 0.4 s

slice 6 (Jess 2026-10-31): cd 0.7 (move-overrides.js). Casts at the first step and 0.7 s later, the third would be at about 1.42 s, so 2 in 1.1 s; the old 0.5 would cast 3 times (about 0.02, 0.52, 1.02)

cast emitter every 0.08, count 3, spread 0: three shots one after another, each a fresh instance that hits the enemy 40 px ahead once. Slice 6: each shot loops round a base point drifting at 90 px/s (radius 70, 0.6667 Hz, centred), starting 70 px across. It sweeps round the enemy on the first loop (never nearer than about 64 px) and meets it on the way back, three quarters of a loop in: at age 1.125 it is at (31.25, 0), 8.75 px off, first within 17 px at about age 1.083 (1.10 at 1/30), plus one step for the deferred child

slice 6 (Jess 2026-10-31, D38): each shot loops round a base point that drifts along the aim at 90 px/s, radius 70, 0.6667 loops per s, centred on it, starting at the top of the loop (0, -70). Half a loop in (age 0.75, theta pi) it is at the bottom, 90 x 0.75 = 67.5 px along and 70 px across, so an enemy at (67.5, 70) is met by all 3 shots (first within 17 px at about age 0.667, plus one step for the deferred child); a loop hanging off the caster instead would be 140 px across there and miss
two rings 0.2 s apart (count 2), each growing to 110 px (slice 6, was 220): the enemy at 100 px is hit by each, the one at 300 px by neither; the emitter and both rings end by time
slice 6 (Jess 2026-10-31): each ring grows to 110 px in 0.4 s (275 px/s), so with the enemy's 10 px body it reaches 120 px: the enemy at 95 px is hit by both rings, the one at 125 px by neither
persistent casterMove emitter: one patch per 0.1 s of owner MOVING time, so a caster that never moves lays none (the moving trail is in move-emit-harness.js test 4)
persistent casterMove emitter, every 0.12 s of moving time: a caster that never moves lays no patch

slice 6 (Jess 2026-10-31, replaces toxic-spikes-rings): placed at the caster's feet (D-LOC), the plate bursts ONCE when it ends at about 3 s; the ring is 100 px growing 400 px/s for 0.25 s, so it reaches 140 px (150 minus the enemy's 10) 0.1 s later, never 240 px; the plate and its one ring end by time
turret at the caster's feet for 6 s, a shot every 0.8 s from 0.8 (7 shots) at the nearest enemy within 300 px; the one at 350 px is never shot; first contact after about 183 px at 300 px/s
an enemy at 350 px passes the 420 px placement gate, so the turret is placed, but it is outside the 300 px shot range
the punch stops on enemy 0 (pierce 0); 3 shards leave its position at -0.3, 0, +0.3 rad and ignore it; each shard hits the enemy on its line 100 px on
mine of 40 px at the caster's feet (D-LOC): it goes off on the first step, trapping every enemy touching it (30 and 45 px), then it is gone; 100 px is untouched
